points.description: States TRUE. Awarded only if the justification in P2 is also given, since the question says no correct justification means no marks.

Justifies that the OS still gets scheduling opportunities without the timer interrupt, by pointing to a non-timer event at which the OS can run the scheduler and switch the CPU to another READY process. A system call is the example given in the model answer. Equivalent wording, or another non-timer event such as an I/O event, earns the mark. Saying only that the OS 'can schedule processes' without naming an event that gives it control does not earn the mark.
